scaffold._discoveryPainPoints:
1. [ProcessHandoffFriction] Sales team wastes 3 days per week on admin and meetings instead of selling (intensity 8/10, stage: Prospect Identified) ← flagged as binding
2. [DataSignalFriction] Salesforce lacks customer intelligence for route planning, requiring manual information gathering (intensity 7/10, stage: Customer Briefed) ← flagged as binding
3. [TechnologyIntegrationFriction] NetSuite integration project delayed from 3 months to 9+ months (intensity 9/10, stage: Order Received) ← flagged as binding
4. [TechnologyIntegrationFriction] 90+ Salesforce customizations making standard implementations difficult (intensity 8/10, stage: Solution Proposed) ← flagged as binding
5. [IncentiveCapacityFriction] Distributors become order takers rather than proactive sellers due to lack of tools (intensity 6/10, stage: Partner Productive)
6. [ProcessHandoffFriction] Staff use multiple disparate systems due to process gaps, creating manual work (intensity 7/10, stage: Order Fulfilled) ← flagged as binding

A customer receiving ongoing maintenance and support services

pc_data_privacy.name: Customer Data Privacy Policy
pc_data_privacy.description: Ensures customer personal and business information is protected throughout all business processes

outcomes.description: Must obtain explicit consent before collecting customer data
Must encrypt all customer data in transit and at rest
Cannot share customer data with unauthorized parties

pc_quality_assurance.name: Product Quality Assurance Policy
pc_quality_assurance.description: Mandates quality checks and validation at critical points in the order fulfillment and service delivery process

outcomes.description: Must perform quality inspection before product delivery
Must validate system functionality before commissioning
Must document all quality check results

pc_partner_certification.name: Partner Certification Requirements
pc_partner_certification.description: Establishes mandatory training and certification requirements for trade partners before activation

outcomes.description: Must complete all required training modules before partner activation
Must pass certification assessment with minimum 80% score
Cannot activate partners without valid certification

pc_contract_compliance.name: Contract Compliance Policy
pc_contract_compliance.description: Ensures all service delivery activities comply with contractual obligations and service level agreements

outcomes.description: Must meet contractual response times for service requests
Must maintain service level agreement compliance above 95%
Must notify customers of any potential service delays

pc_inventory_control.name: Inventory Control Policy
pc_inventory_control.description: Governs inventory allocation, stock management, and availability controls across order fulfillment and service operations

outcomes.description: Must verify inventory availability before confirming orders
Must maintain minimum stock levels for critical service parts
Cannot allocate inventory beyond confirmed availability
